name: Virtuaria – Magalu Marketplace Integration
author: Virtuaria

sections.description:
A free integration plugin that connects WooCommerce to Magazine Luiza. It lets you send selected WooCommerce products to Magalu Marketplace, import orders automatically, and manage the integration according to Magalu’s recommended workflow. You can also increase product prices to offset marketplace fees. Simplify store management and expand your sales channels.

✅ Main Features:

  • Easy Installation and Configuration: An intuitive interface for a quick and straightforward setup.
  • Selected Products: Choose which products are sent to Magazine Luiza Marketplace, giving you greater control over your catalog.
  • Automatic Order Import: Automatically synchronizes orders created on Magazine Luiza with your WooCommerce store so you do not miss a sale.
  • Order Management: Automatically imports paid Magazine Luiza orders into your store.
  • Price Adjustments: Automatically add a percentage to product prices to offset marketplace fees and protect your profit margin.

👨🏾‍🎓 Questions and Support

– See the frequently asked questions in the FAQ;
– Visit the plugin support forum;
– WhatsApp: +55 79 999312134.

🔐 Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

We are committed to privacy and transparency. We prioritize data protection and clear usage policies.
Magazine Luiza Privacy Policy
Virtuaria Privacy Policy

Notes

  • Magazine Luiza is one of Brazil’s leading marketplaces. This plugin was developed independently, without sponsorship or incentives from Magazine Luiza, based on Magalu’s official documentation. None of the plugin developers are affiliated with Magazine Luiza.

🌍 External Services

This integration requires access to Magalu API services. The API credential endpoint (https://id.magalu.com/oauth/token), the Magalu API (https://api.magalu.com/), and services.magalu.com provide the features required to create and update products, retrieve orders, generate integration credentials, and perform other Magalu operations. The plugin also uses https://magalu.virtuaria.com.br to renew and keep integration credentials current. Only the refresh token stored by the shop is sent to this service during renewal.

Compatibility

Compatible with WooCommerce 5.8.0 or later.
sections.installation:
Plugin installation:

  • Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin installer.
  • Activate the plugin.
  • Open Virtuaria Magalu, enter the email address and Brazilian company registration number (CNPJ) associated with your Magalu seller account, and save the settings.
  • Click Connect.
  • Grant the requested permissions.
  • Save the settings again.

After these steps, you can send products to Magalu and automatically receive sales data.

Requirements:

  1. A seller account on Magalu.
  2. WooCommerce installed and active.

Plugin settings screen:

After installing the plugin, open the WordPress administration area and go to “Virtuaria Magalu”.
sections.faq:
1 – What is the plugin license?

This plugin is licensed under GPLv3. The code is fully open source. There is no PRO version with additional features.

2 – What do I need to use this plugin?

  • A current version of WooCommerce.
  • A Magalu seller account.
